answer: Let B denote the beacon set of pretrusted validators and delta the spectral gap; Cheeger's bound confines any coalition that would raven the honest core behind cuts of conductance O(sqrt(delta)), so personalized EigenTrust mass seeded at B attenuates geometrically with reset alpha across each barrier. Adversarial influence at hop k then decays as (1-alpha)^k, vanishing exponentially, while honest scores converge to the dominant eigenvector, yielding asymptotic consensus.
